title: Energy Canyon
description: Have fun in this energy themed mod all about, ELECTRICITY!
body: This mod adds electricity to the game, by using redstone to power an Energizer, to then create batterys and power an Electric Furnace, make an Electric Sword to electricute enemys. A new villager proffesion, the Scrapper, will give you battery casing, burn non-raw-ores to get Burnt Unusefulness, to craft, dirt, and Burnt Unusefulness Block. Even craft Copper Nuggets! This mod is also designed to add an electric feel to the game, and travel to the Dimension Of Energy, and find an abandoned lab! Overall this mod adds a fun, adventure to the game.
